lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D lattice of high-luminance circular blobs is observed posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns within the visible field. The arrangement follows a rectangular grid geometry where the distance between centroids is relatively uniform.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with the horizontal carinae and the circular blobs to form a distinct grid. The blobs are centered at the intersections of these vertical stripes and the horizontal ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible across the mid-to-upper flank. Each ridge shows a high-contrast gradient with a high-intensity luminance peak on the dorsal side and a low-intensity shadow cast on the ventral side, maintaining a parallel trajectory relative to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and the central surface area of the fin's macro-mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, elongated, high-reflectance object consistent with an attached remora is visible on the lower lateral flank. A faint, thin linear mark of lower intensity is observed running horizontally near the dorsal-most visible ridge towards the posterior.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a high-density cluster of micro-blobs, which are significantly smaller and more randomly distributed than the organized grid found on the lateral flank.
